## Empowering a sustainable future for our planet

Agilent supports more than 285,000 laboratories across 110 countries—advancing scientific discovery
and innovation on a global scale.

The Agilent Foundation partners with organizations that advance STEM education, promote global
wellbeing, and build climate resilience.

Agilent is advancing science with purpose—embedding circular economy principles to drive sustainable
innovation and long-term impact.

Agilent is deepening its collaboration with My Green Lab as a top-tier Transformative Sponsor, while
expanding our portfolio of ACT-labeled products to support more sustainable science.

# We believe in the power of science to transform our world.

Together with scientists and operators worldwide, we empower progress by providing trusted insights
and services that accelerate work and amplify impact for a healthier, safer, and more sustainable
world.

# We drive efficiency and empower sustainable scientific discovery with nearly 90 years of
# pioneering innovation.

[Discover More][243]


## By your side, globally.

Offices in 35 countries.

Customers served in 168 countries (direct and through distributors).

Manufacturing presence in North-America, Europe and APAC, incl. China.


## People power progress.

We believe great ideas can come from anywhere – because our customers rely on the ingenuity,
creativity, and passion of our people.

We’re on a mission to transform our world. Will you join us?

[Explore Careers][244]

[Shop Now][245]

## Insights & News


###### [PerkinElmer Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report, Advancing its Commitment to Cleaner
###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

strategic growth platforms.

## Insights & News


###### [PerkinElmer Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report, Advancing its Commitment to Cleaner
###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

## Delivering Excellence Through Science With Quality, Trust And Innovation.

### APIs

We produce high-quality, reliable APIs like antibiotics, antidiabetics, and anti-inflammatories with
GMP certified plants and global regulatory compliance.

### Intermediates

Our broad range of intermediates such as fluoroquinolones and nitroimidazoles supports complex API
development with scalable, R&D backed solutions.

### Specialty Chemicals

We offer Salicylic Acid, Trimethylamine, Dimethylamine, Monomethylamine, Benzene Sulphonyl Chloride,
and Methyl Nicotinate.

### Amines

Our broad range of intermediates such as fluoroquinolones and nitroimidazoles supports complex API
development with scalable, R&D backed solutions.

### Contract Manufacture

Our broad range of intermediates such as fluoroquinolones and nitroimidazoles supports complex API
development with scalable, R&D backed solutions.

About

## AARTI DRUGS LTD.

Aarti Drugs Ltd. was established in the year 1984 and forms part of $900 Million Aarti Group of
Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation
(MIDC) in close vicinity to manufacturing locations.
* The Company is engaged in the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Pharma
  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary
  – Pinnacle Life Science Private Limited.
* Products under APIs includes Ciprofloxacin Hydrochloride, Metronidazole, Metformin HCL,
  Ketoconazole, Ofloxacin etc. whereas Specialty Chemicals includes Salicylic acid, Trimethylamine,

## turning cells into reagents

Understanding frozen cells as a consumable reagent will significantly change your cell-based assays.
Difficult-to-control cell culture variabilities that impact the assay performance are excluded from
the process and lead to an improved assay precision. instaCELLs are available just as you need them.
You can work with the same lot of cells today and for years to come, and share the same qualified
cells with affiliate labs.

### assay ready instaCELLs

In the early 2000s acCELLerate’s founders and scientists pioneered the assay ready approach and were
the first in Europe offering custom frozen ready-to-use cells.

Today the use of qualified cell reagents is broadly accepted for multiple applications:
* High-throughput-screening (HTS) and safety pharmacology in drug discovery
* New Approach Methodologies (NAM’s) for safety assessment of chemicals and medical devices.
* GMP bioassays for the development and quality control of biologics and ATMPs.

Major pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, CROs and CDMOs, ingredient manufacturers and
safety testing laboratories rely on acCELLerate‘s more than 20 years of experience working with over
1,500 different cell lines.

### functional cryopreservation

The idea of using frozen cells in an assay without prior cultivation raised the quality bar of
cryopreservation.
To be truly assay-ready, cells should enter proliferation without a significant lag-phase and
perform in a cell-based assay equally to continuously passaged cells.
Proper cell handling, optimized freezing media, and a controlled freezing process are hallmarks of a
functional cryopreservation.

[make your cell bank fit your assay]
custom CELL banking

acCELLerate will support you to find the right cell banking strategy tailored for your individual
project. This could be a high-throughput screening campaign where you need a large amount of cells
in a short time, routine safety testing where you occasionally run the same set of assays, or a
GMP-bioassay for the potency testing of biologics where you need a reliable source of precisely
performing cells for years.

### tiered cell banking strategy

We strongly promote tiered cell banking starting from a small token stock, followed by a carefully
characterized Master Cell Bank (MCB), a reasonably sized Working Cell Bank (WCB) and finally
hundreds of aliquots of instaCELLs for consumable use. This approach ensures that you work with
cells of the same genealogy and similar passage number throughout the lifecycle of your project or
product.

### cell bank storage & global on-demand supply

acCELLerate assists you to manage your cell banks and storage logistics. Not every lab is prepared
to store thousands of cryovials under properly controlled conditions. Therefore, we provide custom
storage for your cell banks and on-demand delivery. This may also include an automatic replenishment
of assay ready instaCELLs to enable an uninterrupted supply of qualified cells.

of your bioassay across all sites.

## let our experts guide you through the process

Because of our broad experience with many different cell types and a lean and transparent quoting
process we only need very little basic information to provide you with a proposal for your project.
All the information that you provide will be covered by our confidentiality statement. 

[Request a project][24]

[benefits of instaCELLs embedded in a kit]
instaCELL® kits

## benefits of instaCELLs embedded in a kit

Some cell-based assays are generically following guidance documents of OECD, EP/USP, or ISO. To meet
the demand of testing labs for qualified cells to support these assays, acCELLerate has developed a
portfolio of kits which combine assay ready instaCELLs, plates, media, reagents, and controls with a
validated protocol. 

### instaCELL safety testing kits

Chemical ingredients of cosmetics and other products, extractables from medical devices, and
pharmaceuticals need to be tested for their safety. New Approach Methodologies (NAM’s) are in the
process of replacing animal tests regulated in the respective guidelines.

acCELLerate supports the transition to animal-free assays with the development of safety testing
kits, which include ready-to-use instaCELLs:
* Cytotoxicity / Biocompatibility
* Skin Sensitization / KeratinoSens
* Genotoxicity / Micronucleus Assay
* Pyrogen Detection / MAT-Assay

### instaCELL bioassay kits

Biosimilars of well-established biologics like therapeutic neutralizing antibodies, peptides and
cytokines must be tested for their potency by using generic bioassays outlined in the respective
monographs of a pharmacopoeia. To add the benefits of assay ready instaCELLs to these tests, the
improvement of assay precision and flexibility, acCELLerate has developed generic bioassay kits
which include assay ready instaCELLs: 
* TNF-a neutralization (L-929 rescue)
* G-CSF (NFS-60 proliferation)
* GM-CSF (TF-1 proliferation)
* IL-2 (CTLL-2 proliferation)

You’ll find all our instaCELL kits plus accessory products in our online shop. 

[SHOP NOW][25]

[cell quality - the essence of a successful assay]
Quality

## cell quality - the essence of a successful assay

If the cells used in a cell-based assay are of inconsistent quality, the assay is likely to fail. By
using qualified assay ready instaCELL you exclude the main source of cell variability and bad assay
reproducibility. Therefore, it is even more important that we at acCELLerate take extraordinary care
about the quality of the cells we prepare.

### quality assurance

Aligned with the OECD guidance of Good Cell Culture Practice (GCCP), acCELLerate has established
high standards in its lab to enable consistent and reproducible cell maintenance, expansion,
cryopreservation, storage, and recovery. Only qualified reagents are used, and all critical
equipment is well maintained and qualified for its purpose. To consider the individual requirements
of different types of cells, generic SOPs are complemented with Custom Operating Procedures
developed for individual cell line projects. These form a strong backbone for the preparation of
cell banks to ensure high cell quality and batch-to-batch reproducibility. acCELLerate maintains a
quality management system certified according to ISO 9001:2015.

### quality control

All the cell banks we prepare will be carefully checked before being released and shipped to you.
The standard QC package includes:
* Cells:
  cell recovery, viability, growth, and batch homogeneity
* Purity:
  sterility, test for mycoplasma and adventitious viruses
* Identity:
  STR analysis, species, morphology, and biomarkers
* Performance:
  target expression and functional assays

GMP-bioassay for the potency testing of biologics where you need a reliable source of precisely
performing cells for years.

### tiered cell banking strategy

We strongly promote tiered cell banking starting from a small token stock, followed by a carefully
characterized Master Cell Bank (MCB), a reasonably sized Working Cell Bank (WCB) and finally
hundreds of aliquots of instaCELLs for consumable use. This approach ensures that you work with
cells of the same genealogy and similar passage number throughout the lifecycle of your project or
product.

### cell bank storage & global on-demand supply

acCELLerate assists you to manage your cell banks and storage logistics. Not every lab is prepared
to store thousands of cryovials under properly controlled conditions. Therefore, we provide custom
storage for your cell banks and on-demand delivery. This may also include an automatic replenishment
of assay ready instaCELLs to enable an uninterrupted supply of qualified cells. 

For the quality control of a commercial product, the same validated potency assay often needs to be
run at different testing sites. acCELLerate has established a global distribution strategy with
cryo-warehouses in Europe, USA, and prospectively Asia. Your affiliate labs and approved CROs &
CDMOs can request and share instaCELLs from the same qualified lot to increase the reproducibility
of your bioassay across all sites.

## let our experts guide you through the process

Because of our broad experience with many different cell types and a lean and transparent quoting
process we only need very little basic information to provide you with a proposal for your project.
All the information that you provide will be covered by our confidentiality statement. 

[Request a project][24]

[benefits of instaCELLs embedded in a kit]
instaCELL® kits

## benefits of instaCELLs embedded in a kit

Some cell-based assays are generically following guidance documents of OECD, EP/USP, or ISO. To meet
the demand of testing labs for qualified cells to support these assays, acCELLerate has developed a
portfolio of kits which combine assay ready instaCELLs, plates, media, reagents, and controls with a
validated protocol. 

### instaCELL safety testing kits

Chemical ingredients of cosmetics and other products, extractables from medical devices, and
pharmaceuticals need to be tested for their safety. New Approach Methodologies (NAM’s) are in the
process of replacing animal tests regulated in the respective guidelines.

acCELLerate supports the transition to animal-free assays with the development of safety testing
kits, which include ready-to-use instaCELLs:
* Cytotoxicity / Biocompatibility
* Skin Sensitization / KeratinoSens
* Genotoxicity / Micronucleus Assay
* Pyrogen Detection / MAT-Assay

### instaCELL bioassay kits

Biosimilars of well-established biologics like therapeutic neutralizing antibodies, peptides and
cytokines must be tested for their potency by using generic bioassays outlined in the respective
monographs of a pharmacopoeia. To add the benefits of assay ready instaCELLs to these tests, the
improvement of assay precision and flexibility, acCELLerate has developed generic bioassay kits
which include assay ready instaCELLs: 
* TNF-a neutralization (L-929 rescue)
* G-CSF (NFS-60 proliferation)
* GM-CSF (TF-1 proliferation)
* IL-2 (CTLL-2 proliferation)

You’ll find all our instaCELL kits plus accessory products in our online shop. 

[SHOP NOW][25]

[cell quality - the essence of a successful assay]
Quality

## cell quality - the essence of a successful assay

If the cells used in a cell-based assay are of inconsistent quality, the assay is likely to fail. By
using qualified assay ready instaCELL you exclude the main source of cell variability and bad assay
reproducibility. Therefore, it is even more important that we at acCELLerate take extraordinary care
about the quality of the cells we prepare.

### quality assurance

Aligned with the OECD guidance of Good Cell Culture Practice (GCCP), acCELLerate has established
high standards in its lab to enable consistent and reproducible cell maintenance, expansion,
cryopreservation, storage, and recovery. Only qualified reagents are used, and all critical
equipment is well maintained and qualified for its purpose. To consider the individual requirements
of different types of cells, generic SOPs are complemented with Custom Operating Procedures
developed for individual cell line projects. These form a strong backbone for the preparation of
cell banks to ensure high cell quality and batch-to-batch reproducibility. acCELLerate maintains a
quality management system certified according to ISO 9001:2015.

### quality control

All the cell banks we prepare will be carefully checked before being released and shipped to you.
The standard QC package includes:
* Cells:
  cell recovery, viability, growth, and batch homogeneity
* Purity:
  sterility, test for mycoplasma and adventitious viruses
* Identity:
  STR analysis, species, morphology, and biomarkers
* Performance:
  target expression and functional assays

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class

Welcome To Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.

We deliver affordable and quality medicines across the world, regardless of geographic and
socio-economic barriers. This aptitude of ours can be credited to our successful portfolio of
businesses.

Through our efficient manufacturing services backed with highly qualified technical team, we
endeavor to build blocks to produce an organization that manufactures therapeutics for a variety of
diseases.

[Click here to][22] Download Our Brochure!

### Our Mission

We strive for a happier, healthier tomorrow. We shall be working on total customer satisfaction and
achieve leadership in pharmaceutical marketplace, products and services across the globe, through
excellence in technology, based on research and development , compliance with regulatory
requirements and expectation in an effective and efficient manner. Our human resources will continue
to be the most valuable asset in this pursuit of leadership and the prime driving forces for our
growth. We are responsible to society. We shall be good corporate citizens and will be driven by
high ethical standardizing our practices.

### Our Vision

Our vision is to be leading pharmaceutical company in India and become a significant global player.
Our aim is to be a global player, will lead to the establishment of operation in the key markets of
the world including the developing countries. We apply to enrich our people – our driving force, to
become highly competent professional and technology based.

Event Participation
* **CPHI Worldwide**
* **Arab Health**
* **IPHEX**
* **CPHI India**
Why Choose Us

Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. is a young & emerging global pharmaceutical manufacturing &
marketing company. We manufacture & market a broad range of Pharmaceutical finished formulations.

In the year 2000, Mr. Jitendra Prasad, a young Engineering graduate having pharmaceutical project
background, had established Akriti Export Agencies. In very short span of time he had given a
profitable shape of business to Akriti Export Agencies because of his hard work and very positive
mental attitude. Our activities range from manufacturing & marketing of finished pharmaceutical
formulations of Niche therapeutic segments. Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. has its headquarter in
Thane suburb of Mumbai, the financial capital of India .

Akriti Pharmaceuticals has operation in ** CIS Countries** and now expanding its wings to
**European, South East Asian, Latin American, Middle East & African countries**.

Our manufacturing unit has been approved with various International certifications and follows the
laid down norms of FDA India, CGMP under Schedule 'M' as well as it is **WHO-GMP **certified.

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

interests—and eventually her whole career.

[Watch now! ][19]

U.S., offering biopharmaceutical companies of all sizes a proven, flexible approach to early drug
development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),
bioanalysis (preclinical to Phase IV), research services, and manufacturing and analytical services.

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

## WHAT WE DO

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.

  Clinical pharmacology trials from first-in-human to end of Phase II

  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Manufacturing and Analytical Services ][25]

* [ [thumb] ][26]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Bioanalysis Services ][27]

* [ [research support services] ][28]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Research Support Services ][29]

We work as a flexible, attentive extension of your team; we offer the contract research organization

transparency, compliance, and decision-making.

[A Day in the Life of A Molecule]

#### A Day in the Life of A Molecule

Press play to meet Mike the Molecule—he’s got big dreams and a big journey ahead! Follow along as he
takes on every stage of drug development here at Altasciences.Science has never been this fun!

[Learn more! ][18]

[A Day in the Life of a Veterinary Scientist, Ophthalmology]

#### A Day in the Life of a Veterinary Scientist, Ophthalmology

Marianna Bacellar-Galdino has always loved scientific research, and after a particularly eye-opening
project in veterinary school, ophthalmology became the thread connecting all her scientific
interests—and eventually her whole career.

[Watch now! ][19]

We are a forward-thinking, mid-size early phase contract research organization, in Canada and the
U.S., offering biopharmaceutical companies of all sizes a proven, flexible approach to early drug
development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),
bioanalysis (preclinical to Phase IV), research services, and manufacturing and analytical services.

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

## WHAT WE DO

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

## Follow us and keep up to date

have a growing demand globally. The company is linked with developed pieces of equipment of the

### We are Helping to Advance Health with Clinical Trials for Medicine.

APMIDA PHARMACEUTICALS Pvt. Ltd. is a vertically integrated company that develops, manufactures, and
sells Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API), High Potency API, and API intermediates. Our unique
research and synthesis facility reflects our commitment to research and innovation. The world-class
manufacturing facilities at APMIDA PHARMACEUTICALS Pvt. Ltd. are located in Dist. Rampur (UP)India.
These facilities are benchmarked to international standards and set to meet the rigorous quality
guideline, which is critical in achieving our global growth aspirations.

As a leading API supplier, our regulatory-approved facilities enable us to supply our partners all
over countries with a broad portfolio of products. Our expertise spans a variety of chemical
processes, Heterocyclic chemistry, Carbohydrates chemistry. Additionally, we manage enzyme
conversions for some of our products. Our manufacturing capacity for various categories ranges from
500MT/year to 800MT/Year.

## Detect what others miss

### The ATCC Universal Mycoplasma Detection Kit detects over 120 species with high sensitivity,
### helping you protect the integrity of your cell cultures and ensure confidence in your results.

[Learn more][10]

## Physiologically relevant PBMCs

### Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) deliver consistent, assay-ready performance to model
### responses and generate reliable data.

[Learn more][11]

## Build better, more reliable molecular diagnostic assays

### Power your assays with quantitative genomic and synthetic nucleic acids designed for accuracy,
### confidence, and reproducibility.

[Explore now][12]

## More predictive research starts with advanced models

### Leverage human‑relevant organoid models to gain deeper insights into disease biology and
### therapeutic response.

[Explore organoids][13]

 

[ [Fluorescent blue and green spheres of leukemic cells.] ][14]

### Oncology and immuno-oncology

Discover advanced biological models and patient-derived cell lines that can help you transform the
cancer treatment landscape.

[Discover now][15]
[ [Green and red organoid cells.] ][16]

### Toxicology and safety testing

Streamline your toxicological studies by incorporating credible models that support every phase of
your research and testing process.

[Streamline your studies][17]
[ [Red tipped multi-channel pipettor above multicolored well plates.] ][18]

### Molecular diagnostics development

Develop and validate your molecular diagnostic assays faster with relevant, ready-to-use reference
materials.

[Find assay development tools][19]
[ [iStock-1184455932.jpg] ][20]

### Reference-quality 'omics data

Combine the power of physical standards with authenticated whole-genome and whole-transcriptome
data.

[Explore now][21]
[ [Scientist injecting liquid into a microtiter plate] ][22]

### Bioproduction

Discover credible resources for industrial bioprocessing, vaccine development, antibody production,
and protein expression.

[Find resources][23]
[ [Gloved hand putting samples into centrifuge machine.] ][24]

### Standards and controls

Support your testing and assay development needs with high-quality reference materials and national
consensus standards from ATCC.

[Learn more][25]

 

## See what's new

[ [_DSC1890.tif] ][26]

### New Products

Through targeted acquisitions and our own internal research and development efforts, ATCC provides
the authenticated, cutting-edge products you need to make incredible discoveries.

[Explore new products][27]
[ [Scientists Working in The Laboratory iStock-1181391587.jpg] ][28]

### Coming Soon Products

Explore our coming soon products for a preview of what our team is developing for diagnostics
development, drug discovery, toxicology profiling, analytical testing, and more. 

[See what's coming next][29]

 

ATCC (American Type Culture Collection) is a nonprofit, global biological resource center and
standards organization and the leading developer and supplier of authenticated cells lines and
microorganisms. We leverage our rich history and knowledge to provide the products, services, and
resources scientists need to conduct critical life science research.

## Translating innovative biology
## into bioactive molecules

## Axxam is your gateway to innovation, delivering discovery solutions and trusted scientific
## expertise.

## Harness Biology,
## Empower Discovery.

## As a Contract Research Organization (CRO), our team of experienced scientists provides services
## for the identification and validation of bioactive molecules across the life sciences industry.

# Within the drug discovery disciplines, Axxam supports pharmaceutical and biotech companies,
# start-ups, patient foundations, and academic groups in their journey from target validation to hit
# and lead identification. We offer integrated early discovery services and solutions, regardless of
# the therapeutic area or target class. 

The same science-driven approach is applied to identify new bioactive compounds for crop protection
and animal health. Through our research platform [AXXSense][198], we also discover novel flavours,
fragrances and taste imparting or modulating ingredients to support the food & beverage, flavors &
fragrances, pet food, cosmetics, and perfume industries.

## We understand your needs and
## provide solutions, even for your
## most challenging projects.

## Our values

**Passionate about science**
Our team is fueled by an unwavering passion for science, boundless curiosity, and a creative spirit.
This drive for discovery empowers Axxam to explore new frontiers and uncover innovative solutions.

**Talent in discovery**
We have a deep commitment to tackling even the most complex and challenging early-stage discovery
projects, combining innovation and expertise to deliver meaningful results.

**Transparent communication**
We value communication as the foundation for building strong, efficient, and effective relationships
with our clients. Open and transparent dialogue fosters an environment where innovation can thrive.

**Trusted quality**
Our projects are built on rigorous procedures that ensure the highest standards of quality and data
security. Precision, transparency, and effective collaboration are the principles that guide us.

## Axxam is your gateway to innovation, delivering discovery solutions and trusted scientific
## expertise.

## Harness Biology,
## Empower Discovery.

## As a Contract Research Organization (CRO), our team of experienced scientists provides services
## for the identification and validation of bioactive molecules across the life sciences industry.

# Within the drug discovery disciplines, Axxam supports pharmaceutical and biotech companies,
# start-ups, patient foundations, and academic groups in their journey from target validation to hit
# and lead identification. We offer integrated early discovery services and solutions, regardless of
# the therapeutic area or target class. 

The same science-driven approach is applied to identify new bioactive compounds for crop protection
and animal health. Through our research platform [AXXSense][198], we also discover novel flavours,
fragrances and taste imparting or modulating ingredients to support the food & beverage, flavors &
fragrances, pet food, cosmetics, and perfume industries.

## We understand your needs and
## provide solutions, even for your
## most challenging projects.

## Our values

**Passionate about science**
Our team is fueled by an unwavering passion for science, boundless curiosity, and a creative spirit.
This drive for discovery empowers Axxam to explore new frontiers and uncover innovative solutions.

**Talent in discovery**
We have a deep commitment to tackling even the most complex and challenging early-stage discovery
projects, combining innovation and expertise to deliver meaningful results.

**Transparent communication**
We value communication as the foundation for building strong, efficient, and effective relationships
with our clients. Open and transparent dialogue fosters an environment where innovation can thrive.

**Trusted quality**
Our projects are built on rigorous procedures that ensure the highest standards of quality and data
security. Precision, transparency, and effective collaboration are the principles that guide us.

## Frequently Asked Questions

## **What is comparability testing and why is it important?** 

Comparability testing helps sponsors evaluate whether product quality attributes remain consistent
following manufacturing, process, formulation, or analytical changes. Comparability testing
strategies support product characterization, regulatory submissions, manufacturing consistency, and
long-term product quality objectives.
Comparability testing for CMC focuses on product consistency as the development and manufacturing
process changes, ensuring that historical clinical safety and efficacy data remains valid as the
product progresses from early phase to commercialization.
In contrast, comparability testing for bioanalytical testing focuses on data continuity, proving
that when analytical methods or platforms change during clinical development the new assays generate
data that is scientifically equivalent to historical clinical data, which is critical to proper
interpretation of key clinical readouts impacting both safety and efficacy.

## When should bioanalytical assay development begin?

Assay development must begin during later discovery and lead molecule optimization, long before the
first human is dosed. Assays should begin as early as possible in preclinical or early clinical
stages to ensure methods are optimized, validated, and ready to support critical study timelines
preventing delays in regulatory submissions and clinical starts.

## What is immunogenicity testing and when is it required?

Immunogenicity testing is the bioanalytical assessment of a patient’s immune response to a
therapeutic product. Specifically testing that evaluates a patient’s anti-drug antibody (ADA) and
neutralizing antibodies (NAbs) responses to biologic therapies. It is required continuously
throughout clinical development to assess potential impacts on safety, efficacy, and
pharmacokinetics.

## **Can BioAgilytix support complex modalities like ADCs, cell and gene therapies, or RNA
## therapeutics?** 

Yes. BioAgilytix has extensive experience supporting complex and emerging modalities, including
ADCs, cell and gene therapies, oligonucleotides, and mRNA, with tailored bioanalytical and CMC
analytical strategies.

## **How does BioAgilytix ensure consistent bioanalytical data across global studies?**

Through harmonized processes, standardized platforms, and integrated quality systems across all
global laboratories, ensuring consistent, high-quality data regardless of study location.

## Frequently Asked Questions

## **What is comparability testing and why is it important?** 

Comparability testing helps sponsors evaluate whether product quality attributes remain consistent
following manufacturing, process, formulation, or analytical changes. Comparability testing
strategies support product characterization, regulatory submissions, manufacturing consistency, and
long-term product quality objectives.
Comparability testing for CMC focuses on product consistency as the development and manufacturing
process changes, ensuring that historical clinical safety and efficacy data remains valid as the
product progresses from early phase to commercialization.
In contrast, comparability testing for bioanalytical testing focuses on data continuity, proving
that when analytical methods or platforms change during clinical development the new assays generate
data that is scientifically equivalent to historical clinical data, which is critical to proper
interpretation of key clinical readouts impacting both safety and efficacy.

## When should bioanalytical assay development begin?

Assay development must begin during later discovery and lead molecule optimization, long before the
first human is dosed. Assays should begin as early as possible in preclinical or early clinical
stages to ensure methods are optimized, validated, and ready to support critical study timelines
preventing delays in regulatory submissions and clinical starts.

## What is immunogenicity testing and when is it required?

Immunogenicity testing is the bioanalytical assessment of a patient’s immune response to a
therapeutic product. Specifically testing that evaluates a patient’s anti-drug antibody (ADA) and
neutralizing antibodies (NAbs) responses to biologic therapies. It is required continuously
throughout clinical development to assess potential impacts on safety, efficacy, and
pharmacokinetics.

## **Can BioAgilytix support complex modalities like ADCs, cell and gene therapies, or RNA
## therapeutics?** 

Yes. BioAgilytix has extensive experience supporting complex and emerging modalities, including
ADCs, cell and gene therapies, oligonucleotides, and mRNA, with tailored bioanalytical and CMC
analytical strategies.

## **How does BioAgilytix ensure consistent bioanalytical data across global studies?**

Through harmonized processes, standardized platforms, and integrated quality systems across all
global laboratories, ensuring consistent, high-quality data regardless of study location.

Free & open — no sign-up required

# Free tools for *fermentation* & cell culture scientists

Calculators, trackers, and optimizers built by bioprocess engineers. Replace your scattered Excel
sheets with purpose-built tools that work on your phone at the bench. Plus vendor-neutral
[side-by-side comparisons][1] and independent [sensor reviews][2].

61
Tools Live
100%
Free Forever
0
Sign-ups Required

## The Toolkit

Every tool a bioprocess scientist needs — from bench to bioreactor. Built for daily use, designed
for mobile.

### Lab Essentials

[

### RPM ↔ g-Force (RCF) Converter

Convert RPM to RCF and back instantly. Rotor presets for Eppendorf, Beckman, Thermo Fisher
centrifuges. Common protocol quick-reference. Mobile-friendly for bench use.

RPM RCF Rotors
][3] [

### Protein MW & Extinction Coefficient

Paste amino acid sequence → get molecular weight, extinction coefficient (ε280), A280 for 1 mg/mL,
estimated pI, charge vs pH curve. Common protein presets.

MW ε280 pI
][4] [

### Molarity & Solution Calculator

Calculate mass from molarity, percent solutions (w/v, v/v, w/w), concentration unit converter (M to
mM, uM, nM). Built-in library of 50+ reagent molecular weights.

Molarity % w/v MW Library
][5] [

### Master Mix Calculator

PCR, qPCR, RT-PCR reaction setup for N reactions with dead volume. 6 protocol presets (Standard PCR,
SYBR, TaqMan, High-Fidelity, Colony PCR, RT). CSV export and pipetting guide.

PCR qPCR Dead Vol
][6] [

### OD600 to Cell Density Converter

Convert optical density to cells/mL, CFU/mL, and dry cell weight. Organism presets for E. coli,
yeast, Pichia, Bacillus. Dilution factor correction and linearity warnings.

OD600 CFU/mL DCW
][7] [

### Transfection Calculator

DNA and reagent volumes for PEI (N:P ratio), Lipofectamine 2000/3000, FuGENE HD, CaPO₄.
Co-transfection with AAV triple and lentiviral 3rd-gen presets. Scale from 96-well to 50 L
bioreactor.

PEI Lipo Co-Transfection
][8] [

### Primer Tm Calculator

Calculate primer melting temperature using nearest-neighbor (SantaLucia 1998), salt-adjusted, and
basic methods. Primer pair analysis with quality scorecard, hairpin detection, and adjustable Na+,
Mg2+, dNTPs.

Tm Nearest-Neighbor PCR
][9] [

### DNA / RNA Calculator

A260 to concentration (ng/uL), mass-to-moles conversion (ng/uL to nM/uM for oligos, plasmids, RNA),
Nanodrop purity check with 260/280 and 260/230 interpretation.

A260 Purity ng→nM
][10] [

### Buffer Preparation Calculator

Stock solution prep, C1V1=C2V2 dilution, Henderson-Hasselbalch pH buffers, serial dilution planner,
and common bioprocess buffer recipes (PBS, Tris, HEPES).

pH Buffer Dilution Recipes
][11] [

### Cell Counting & Viability Calculator

Hemocytometer cell counter with visual grid input. VCD, viability %, passage planner with vessel and
organism presets. Multi-count growth tracking with charts.

VCD Viability Passage
][12]

### Process Monitoring & Analytics

[

### CellTrack — Growth & Viability Tracker

Log VCD, viability, glucose, lactate, titer, pH, DO. Auto-calculates specific growth rate (µ),
doubling time, qP, qGlc, IVC. Beautiful charts. CSV export. Works offline.

CHO E. coli Yeast Mobile-first
][13] [

### Golden Batch Analysis & Cross-Run Comparison

Compare bioreactor runs, build golden batch envelopes (mean ± sigma), align batches on biological
events, find which variable caused a deviation via z-score contribution. Free SIMCA alternative.

Golden batch CPV SIMCA-free
][14] [

### Bioreactor Data Dashboard

Upload CSV from any bioreactor system. Auto-generate time-series charts for DO, pH, VCD,
metabolites. Multi-run overlay. Derived metrics (µ, qP, IVC). Data never leaves your browser.

CSV Charts Private
][15] [

### Growth Curve Fitter & µ Calculator

Paste OD or cell count data, auto-fit exponential, logistic, and Gompertz models. Extract µmax,
doubling time, lag time. Model comparison with R² and AIC.

µmax Gompertz OD600
][16] [

### Monod Kinetics Calculator

Compute µ from µmax, Ks and substrate S, plot the µ–S curve, and fit µmax & Ks from data
(Lineweaver-Burk, Hanes-Woolf, nonlinear). Haldane & dual-substrate models.

µmax Ks Monod
][17] [

### Bioreactor Simulator

Watch a live Monod-model fermentation run in batch, fed-batch or chemostat mode — animated vessel,
dissolved-oxygen coupling, washout and productivity curves. RK4 in your browser.

Interactive Chemostat Fed-batch
][18] [

### ELISA Data Analyzer (4PL Fit)

4-parameter logistic curve fitting for ELISA data. Standard curve with LLOQ/ULOQ, back-calculated
sample concentrations, %CV flagging, accuracy validation.

4PL LLOQ %CV
][19] [

### Protein Concentration Calculator

BCA assay, Bradford assay, and direct A280 protein quantification. Standard curve fitting,
Beer-Lambert law, dilution correction, and purification yield tracker.

BCA Bradford A280
][20] [

### Endotoxin Dilution Calculator

MVD calculation, endotoxin limit by route (IV, intrathecal, ophthalmic), dilution series generator
with pipe

# Free tools for *fermentation* & cell culture scientists

Calculators, trackers, and optimizers built by bioprocess engineers. Replace your scattered Excel
sheets with purpose-built tools that work on your phone at the bench. Plus vendor-neutral
[side-by-side comparisons][1] and independent [sensor reviews][2].

## The Toolkit

Every tool a bioprocess scientist needs — from bench to bioreactor. Built for daily use, designed
for mobile.

# A new focus on Life Science

Empowering Research and Discovery with Cutting-Edge Instruments and Expertise
[ Instruments ][4]
[ Latest articles ][5]

## Who are we

[ About us ][6]

Thanks to a renewed focus and approach, BioSPX has become a leading partner in Life Science. As an
independent supplier of instruments, we assist our customers in making the right choices for the
present and the future.

### Innovation in organoid research

Orgonex's RPMotion bioreactor offers a dynamic environment that significantly accelerates organoid
expansion, achieving up to 5-fold faster growth compared to traditional methods. Small footprint,
big results!
[More about this new partnership][7]

### Spatial Biology beyond co-localization

Most spatial biology tools tell you what proteins are present. None of them tell you if those
proteins are actually doing anything... That's the gap QF-Pro® fills by measuring Förster Resonance
Energy Transfer (FRET) — a quantum mechanical phenomenon in which energy is transferred directly
between two fluorophores when they are within 1–10 nm of each other.
[Read how you can measure Protein–Protein interactions with HAWK Biosystems][8]
[Protein-protein interaction header]

### Flow Cytometry XPerts

With years of experience and cutting-edge solutions in Flow Cytometry, we are ready to inform,
guide, and support you in all your cell analysis needs

### Innovation in organoid research

Orgonex's RPMotion bioreactor offers a dynamic environment that significantly accelerates organoid
expansion, achieving up to 5-fold faster growth compared to traditional methods. Small footprint,
big results!
[More about this new partnership][7]

### Spatial Biology beyond co-localization

Most spatial biology tools tell you what proteins are present. None of them tell you if those
proteins are actually doing anything... That's the gap QF-Pro® fills by measuring Förster Resonance
Energy Transfer (FRET) — a quantum mechanical phenomenon in which energy is transferred directly
between two fluorophores when they are within 1–10 nm of each other.
[Read how you can measure Protein–Protein interactions with HAWK Biosystems][8]

guide, and support you in all your cell analysis needs

# Igniting Progress
# in Precision Medicine

We help accelerate the discovery and development of new therapies and diagnostics by providing
biopharma and diagnostic companies with the highest quality biospecimens, in vitro preclinical
products, and cell & gene therapy starting materials coupled with specialty lab services that are
grounded in science and offered at scale to support large scale clinical trials. 

By enhancing their capabilities, we enable the incredibly important work that our customers are
doing to improve patient outcomes.

[ visit allcells ******************************** ][120]

## The World’s Largest Apheresis Capacity.

Leverage the world’s largest apheresis donor network to achieve greater speed and reliability across
the entire cell and gene therapy, immunological, and oncological continuums from basic discovery
through commercialization.

[ EXPLORE ALLCELLS PRODUCTS ******************************** ][121]

## Definitive Biospecimens.
## Your Search Ends Here.

The world’s largest inventory of quality biospecimens with unrivaled selection and characterization.

foundation for our studies on tumor heterogeneity and therapeutic resistance. We are very satisfied
with the reliability and professionalism of your services.”

# Driving partner success with reliable, expert-driven CDMO services

At Bora Pharmaceuticals, it is our shared responsibility to execute every drug program reliably on
time, consistently in full.

[ Get in touch today ][54]

## A global pharmaceutical manufacturing partner
* From sites in North America and Asia, Bora delivers reliable, high-quality drug products to 100+
  markets around the globe

Bora Pharmaceuticals is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO)
specializing in formulation development, clinical and commercial cGMP manufacturing, and packaging
of complex oral solid dose, liquid, semi-solid, biologic, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical
products.

From our nine cGMP facilities across three countries, Bora Pharmaceuticals delivers drug products
with unparalleled quality to more than 100 markets around the world. Bora’s teams, technologies, and
facilities work seamlessly together with a shared commitment to supporting partners, minimizing
risk, and helping ensure therapies reach patients worldwide.

## Welcome to Creative Bioarray

Creative Bioarray is the world leading biological company whose mission focuses on the acquisition,
authentication, production, and development of standard reference microbial strains, and cell lines.

Creative Bioarray provides life science researchers with high-quality cell-based analysis and
microbial identification services, that can improve research results and increase the speed of
success. We aim to provide customers with high-satisfaction assistance in life science researches
and save time, effort, and money for customers while obtaining perfect data.

## WE PROVIDE CELL-BASED VALIDATION

Cell-based assays are important experimental tools in life science research and biomanufacturing.
The cell-based assay is defined as any assay performed within living cells. Cell-based assays
provide a method to quantitatively analyze the presence, number, or functional activity of cells or
tissues of interest.

As a pioneer in biotechnology, Creative Bioarray has grown into one of the world's largest
independent biotechnology companies. Our scientific team works with you to determine the best assay
design for your needs. We have experience working with a variety of cellular backgrounds, from
easy-to-transfect cell lines to difficult-to-transfect cell lines.

Creative Bioarray is the world leading biological company whose mission focuses on the acquisition,

## WE PROVIDE CELL-BASED VALIDATION

Cell-based assays are important experimental tools in life science research and biomanufacturing.
The cell-based assay is defined as any assay performed within living cells. Cell-based assays
provide a method to quantitatively analyze the presence, number, or functional activity of cells or
tissues of interest.

As a pioneer in biotechnology, Creative Bioarray has grown into one of the world's largest
independent biotechnology companies. Our scientific team works with you to determine the best assay
design for your needs. We have experience working with a variety of cellular backgrounds, from
easy-to-transfect cell lines to difficult-to-transfect cell lines.

  [Understanding The Economic Impacts Of International Branch Campuses (Ibc) In Uzbekistan: Insights
  From Graduates][12]
  (2025-08)
  Tulkinovich, Muratov Bobir
  Show more
  The number of international branch campuses (IBC) in Uzbekistan has grown rapidly in recent
  decades. The government has actively supported the establishment of these institutions with the
  aim of increasing access, quality, and capacity within the higher education system, as well as
  preparing qualified human resources for the national economy. Although the industry has matured
  and some IBCs have already produced several batches of graduates, the actual benefits and impacts
  of these institutions on the economy and society remains unclear. Therefore, this study explores
  the perspectives of IBC graduates on the economic impacts of international branch campuses in
  Uzbekistan, with a focus on human capital development.

  [Investigating Source Apportionment And Ecological Risk Assessment Of Microplastic Pollution In
  The Surface Waters Of Pinang River And Kerian River Using Spatial Analysis][14]
  (2025-09)
  Mohd Rosli, Muhammad Izzul Fahmi
  Show more
  Microplastic pollution in freshwater ecosystems is an emerging environmental concern due to its
  persistence, widespread distribution, and ecological risks. This study investigates the sources,
  distribution, and ecological risks of microplastics in the surface waters of the Pinang River
  (Balik Pulau) and Kerian River (Nibong Tebal), Malaysia. These two rivers are subjected to varied
  land uses, including agriculture, aquaculture, and urban development. The study integrates
  historical water quality data (2017–2021), in-situ measurements, stereomicroscopy, FTIR polymer
  identification, and ecological risk assessment through the Risk Quotient (RQ) method. To identify
  potential pollution sources, secondary water quality data were analyzed using Principal Component
  Analysis (PCA), revealing that both rivers are predominantly impacted by diffuse sources such as
  agricultural runoff, aquaculture effluents, and domestic discharges.

  The number of international branch campuses (IBC) in Uzbekistan has grown rapidly in recent
  decades. The government has actively supported the establishment of these institutions with the
  aim of increasing access, quality, and capacity within the higher education system, as well as
  preparing qualified human resources for the national economy. Although the industry has matured
  and some IBCs have already produced several batches of graduates, the actual benefits and impacts
  of these institutions on the economy and society remains unclear. Therefore, this study explores
  the perspectives of IBC graduates on the economic impacts of international branch campuses in
  Uzbekistan, with a focus on human capital development.

  [Investigating Source Apportionment And Ecological Risk Assessment Of Microplastic Pollution In
  The Surface Waters Of Pinang River And Kerian River Using Spatial Analysis][14]
  (2025-09)
  Mohd Rosli, Muhammad Izzul Fahmi
  Show more
  Microplastic pollution in freshwater ecosystems is an emerging environmental concern due to its
  persistence, widespread distribution, and ecological risks. This study investigates the sources,
  distribution, and ecological risks of microplastics in the surface waters of the Pinang River
  (Balik Pulau) and Kerian River (Nibong Tebal), Malaysia. These two rivers are subjected to varied
  land uses, including agriculture, aquaculture, and urban development. The study integrates
  historical water quality data (2017–2021), in-situ measurements, stereomicroscopy, FTIR polymer
  identification, and ecological risk assessment through the Risk Quotient (RQ) method. To identify
  potential pollution sources, secondary water quality data were analyzed using Principal Component
  Analysis (PCA), revealing that both rivers are predominantly impacted by diffuse sources such as
  agricultural runoff, aquaculture effluents, and domestic discharges.

  The conventional agriculture and food supply chain (AFSC) suffers from concerns such as food
  security, food waste, operational inefficiency, instances of food fraud, and lack of traceability,
  among others. These concerns exist due to a lack of traceability, transparency, digitalization,
  and interconnectedness across AFSC. In addition, the recent COVID-19 pandemic has forced companies
  to adopt digitalization solutions to sustain their business operations. While most businesses
  reverted to existing practices once the pandemic's adversities eased, this implies that the
  adopted system does not meet the needs of AFSC companies. In response, researchers advocated for
  the use of blockchain technology (BCT) to unlock the capabilities of traceability and
  transparency, as well as to offer a secure platform for digitalization. Despite the benefits of
  BCT in improving AFSC, its usage is still in the infancy stage. Therefore, this study aims to
  increase the diffusion of BCT in the Malaysian AFSC by assessing the influence of social capital
  theory and institutional theory. Also, most previous studies have particularly focused on
  intention to adopt, and this study extends the scope by adding two preceding stages: knowledge
  seeking and evaluation of perceived innovation characteristics. The key research objectives are to
  identify the significant determinants of each BCT diffusion stage and examine the moderating role
  of social networks in trust-based relationships.

  Aberrant expression of B cell activating factor (BAFF) has been strongly implicated in a range of
  immunological disorders, particularly autoimmune diseases and lymphoid malignancies. Among the
  various disorders influenced by BAFF dysregulation, systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is
  particularly notable, as elevated levels of BAFF have been consistently reported in patients with
  SLE, thereby positioning BAFF as a promising target for therapeutic intervention. While synthetic
  BAFF antagonists are currently used for treatment, a substantial percentage of patients do not
  respond well to these treatments, justifying the need for alternative approaches with natural
  products from traditional/medicinal plants. Christia vespertilionis (CV), commonly known as the
  butterfly wing plant demonstrated various medicinal properties, though its immunomodulatory
  effects remain largely unexplored. Therefore, this study evaluates the potential immunomodulatory
  effects of aqueous CV leaf extract (CVLE) on BAFF-mediated monocyte proliferation.

  As China’s higher education sector expands, operational-level administrative staff face increasing
  workloads, evolving job expectations, and immense pressure. Ensuring their effectiveness is
  crucial for institutional efficiency, yet research on their performance remains limited. This
  study, based on social exchange theory (SET) and social identity theory (SIT), explores how HRM
  practices, organizational justice, and transformational leadership influence job performance, with
  organizational identification as a moderator.

  [Evaluation Of The Reproductive And Developmental Toxicities Of The Aqueous Extract Of Labisia
  Pumila Var. Alata In Female Rats][22]
  (Universiti Sains Malaysia, 2009-10)
  Mohd Puad, Wan Ezumi
  Show more
  Labisia pumila var. alata (LPA) or Kacip Fatimah has been listed by the government of Malaysia as
  one of the priority species for a multi-disciplinary scientific study towards the development of
  scientific, evidence-based herbal medicine. The present study described in this thesis is part of
  the preclinical assessment of LPA to evaluate its safety profile. The aims of this study were to
  evaluate the potential effects of aqueous extract of LPA on reproductive and developmental
  toxicities in Sprague Dawley rats. A preliminary study was conducted using unstandardised extract
  of LPA at 2, 20, 200 and 400 mg/kg/day. Commercially prepared standard aqueous extract of LPA,
  registered as Biolabisia at the doses of 2, 20, 200, 400, 1000 mg/kg/day or distilled water
  (control) were administered by gavaging to animals during the main studies. The Teratogenic study
  was conducted by treating pregnant animals with Biolabisia during the period of organogenesis.
  Treatments of animals began from the time prior to mating until lactational periods of seven days
  in the Reproductive toxicity study and from before mating up to day 15 of pregnancy in the
  Fertility study. Virgin rats were treated with Biolabisia for duration of three weeks in the
  Female toxicity study. A substantial number of reproductive and developmental parameters were
  assessed throughout this study. All numerical data were analysed using SPSS version 12.0.1.
  Results obtained indicated that the administration of Biolabisia at all dose levels did not cause
  mortality nor show noticeably any treatment-related signs of toxicity on the physical appearance
  and behaviour of all the rats studied.
  Show more

  [Synthesis Of Graphene From Alternative Precursors And The Use Of Quartz Plate For Carbon Source
  Manipulation][24]
  (Universiti Sains Malaysia, 2019-07-01)
  Kairi, Muhammad Izhar
  Show more
  Graphene is a single layer of carbon atoms arranged in an sp2-hybridized structure with properties
  far superior compared to other materials. Research and development in graphene synthesis have been
  rapidly growing the past few years especially using chemical vapor deposition (CVD). However, in
  order to move graphene from laboratory scale to commercial domain; graphene synthesis cost need to
  be continually reduced. In this thesis, this problem was approached from a few angles. One of the
  study in this thesis demonstrate that rice straw and synthetic biogas, typical wastes from the
  rice and palm oil production industries can be used as inexpensive carbon source for the
  production of graphene. In the case of rice straw, the lignocellulosic biomass was first put
  through thermal pyrolysis in order to obtain the bio-oil and bio-char. Only 0.50 mL of bio-oil was
  then used as carbon source to sufficiently synthesized 1 cm x 1 cm of large area graphene with
  good quality (ID/IG = ~0.55) via a two-heating source setup ambient pressure CVD (APCVD) . By
  doing this, the amount of carbon source going out as effluent is reduced as it has been recovered
  as side-products prior to graphene growth. The bio-char was also used as carbon source for
  graphene growth but with a novel and facile carbon trapping assisted APCVD involving customized
  quartz plate. Here, 2.5 mg of bio-char was encapsulated with quartz plate and Cu foil in a
  specific arrangement which acted as carbon shields and trapped the carbon active species at high
  temperature within the confined space of the setup. By implementing carbon trapping, lesser amount
  of carbon source was needed for graphene growth of the same size; graphene growth efficiency

competitive rates.

# Bentham Science Publishers

Bentham Science is one of the leading publishers specializing in science, technology, and medical

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

Today, We Are
* [icon]
  
  ### 52,000 MTPA Capacity – 96+ Billion Tablets/Year
* [icon]
  
  ### Having presence in 65+ countries
* [icon]
  
  ### Backwardly integrated for PAP
* [icon]
  
  ### Forward integration for DC
* [icon]
  
  ### Only Paracetamol Manufacturer with RC Logo (2023)
* [icon]
  
  ### 23% Global Market Share in API Paracetamol
* [icon]
  
  ### 40% Domestic India Market Share in Paracetamol API

## Our Pharmaceutical API Products & Formulations

### Paracetamol API – Multiple Grades for Every Formulation

Paracetamol, being the safest & the most affordable Analgesic & Antipyretic drug, is used for
treating fever, flu, body pain and cold.

### Paracetamol DC Granules – Directly Compressible for Tablet Production

Our DC provides drum-to-feeder compression/encapsulation solutions that are both economically sound
and operationally simple.

### New APIs – Theophylline, Rivaroxaban, Folic Acid & More

Introducing Our Latest API Range from Units 4 & 5

### Caffeine Anhydrous API

EU GMP Certified, 600 MT/Month
