# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

[slide_innovation]
[slide_patient]
[slide_globally]

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

Our strategic focus spans the pivotal therapeutic areas of Oncology, Dermatology, and Respiratory.
By combining our deep scientific expertise with agile commercial strategies, we are uniquely
positioned to deliver our products reliably, responsibly, and sustainably supporting patients,
healthcare professionals, and  healthcare segments worldwide.

## Join Us

At Glenmark, we want talent to build more than a career. We want them to undertake a quest full of
substance and meaning.

Where chasing breakthroughs is part of the everyday and shaping the future of global health the
goal.

Where we live, breathe and deliver innovation while also expanding accessibility to high-quality
products for patients around the world.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

At Glenmark, we want talent to build more than a career. We want them to undertake a quest full of

Where chasing breakthroughs is part of the everyday and shaping the future of global health the

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

[ Collaborations ][61]

[Our chain approach]

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

[ Benefits ][62]

feed chain. Please sign up for our newsletters with information about our scheme, training
opportunities, sector developments, feed legislation and more. In this way you are always informed.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

from several regulatory authorities of different countries.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

What makes it different

## Local and craft makers you won't find on the big networks

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around the small producers the transnational
marketplaces never list: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops, cooperatives and
family farms. Each is checked against an official government registry or a recognized origin mark,
and sorted by category and country, so you can actually find and trust them.

* Verified at the source

* Sorted by category and country

## Matching that explains itself

Every distributor is scored 0 to 100 against a manufacturer's offer on seven weighted criteria, with
a plain-language rationale, not a black box.

* 9%

* 8%
  
  Trade-agreement fit

  (EAEU, EU, ASEAN, USMCA, CPTPP, AfCFTA, bilateral FTAs).

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

### Wide range of innovations; diverse and differentiated product portfolio

[Read More][71]

## At Hetero, our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of
## life-saving medicines across the world.

With unparalleled strengths in pharmaceutical research, manufacturing, and marketing, we are
positioned to serve people regardless of geographies. Our new identity embodies this drive to expand
our reach and capabilities in order to respond with agility to the world’s evolving health needs.
Our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of life-saving
medicines across the world.

## Partnering with MPP to expand access of nirmatrelvir & ritonavir generics for COVID-19 treatment

To ensure significant increase in access to COVID-19 treatments for all people, particularly those
living in the poorest parts of the world.

[Read More][72]

## Positive results in Phase III trials of Hetero’s Movfor (Molnupiravir)

Demonstrated that Molnupiravir along with Standard of Care (SOC) reduced the risk of hospitalization
by over 65% compared to SOC alone.

[Read More][73]

## Hybio

Peptide unlocks the code of life, leading the intelligent and healthy future

We are deeply involved in the field of molecular code breaking for peptides and small nucleic acids,
cultivating a fertile ground for innovative drug research and development through AI intelligent
drug technology, and building a grand blueprint for drug development through the layout of the
entire industry chain. Nowadays, we have achieved international breakthroughs from intelligent
peptide sequence design in our R&D center to obtaining the first generic certification from the US
FDA; Our innovative products have successfully entered the medical systems of over 30 countries,
from precise synthesis of high-purity raw materials to the protection of global patients' lives and
health through high-quality formulations. Relying on our proprietary intellectual property
technology platform and international quality standards, we are continuously providing more
accessible and high-quality treatment options for patients worldwide, enabling innovative drugs to
benefit more lives.

**Wendy Stam**
IBL, Leiden University, the Netherlands

Human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVEC) were cultured in a μ-Slide 8 Well high with a gelatin
coating. The cells were stained for von Willebrand factor (DAKO, green), actin cytoskeleton
(phalloidin, magenta) and nuclei (Hoechst, white). The image is a maximum intensity projection (z =
2 μm, step size = 0.5 μm) taken with a 63x oil objective on a Leica Stellaris 5 microscope.

## Full-Service CRO

Ichor Life Sciences, Inc. is a pre-clinical contract research organization (CRO) with 100% US
operations. The company's extensive service offerings provide hit-to-lead pipeline support spanning
gene-to-structure, cellular screening, in vivo pharmacology, and clinical trials. Ichor culture
drives a staff of "tool builders" who understand assays and techniques at their most fundamental
levels, ensuring the highest level of experimental quality and unprecedented levels of study
customizability.

Contract Research is Decentralized

Contract research organizations (CROs) have emerged as key drivers of scientific innovation by
creating a network powered by global collaboration, highly specialized expertise, and leveraging
advanced technologies. 

Ichor Life Sciences acknowledges that the evolving landscape of research reflects a shift towards
decentralization (DeSci) that not only enhances the efficiency and speed of scientific inquiry, but
also opens up new possibilities for groundbreaking discoveries that transcend traditional
boundaries.

How it Works

We are interested in empowering not only large corporations and academic institutions, but
individuals who are looking to find answers, replicate results, or explore new possibilities.

We coordinate with clients directly to structure transactions in a way that is optimal for all
parties. Learn more by emailing [info@ichorlifesciences.com][140].

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

Akitsu Hotta, Associate Professor at the Center for iPS Cell Research and Application, Kyoto University [hp-quote-icon] We use (the) MaxCyte ATx for T-cell gene editing. It enables us to achieve high knockdown efficiency. Easy, convenient and reproducible. Menggui Huang, Principal Scientist [hp-quote-icon] We discussed the optimization of electroporation conditions with MaxCyte researchers, who provided us with more than 15 optimization programs, and finally found the best one for the manufacture of genetically modified T cells. Director at a United States biotech [hp-quote-icon] With the continued support from research specialists that is included with purchase of the machine, we are confident in our ability to optimize our transfections. Expertise combined with a scalable device. Expertise in the field. Postdoctoral student at a United States university [hp-quote-icon] The technical representatives are knowledgeable and very eager to help and develop solutions in any endeavor. Also, they are very proactive with sharing new developments. Scientist at a global biomedical company [hp-quote-icon] My company had chosen MaxCyte to meet both its research and GMP-scale electroporation needs. Our collaborative approach has supported over 70 clinical trials across diverse indications and is supporting the first every non-viral therapy approved globally. # Accelerating Biologic Discovery with Confidence

[Get Started][21]

Mosaic Biosciences is an integrated biologics discovery partner advancing complex antibody and
protein therapeutics. Our approach combines [antibody discovery][22], [protein engineering][23], and
translational pharmacology to move programs from concept to candidate selection with scientific
rigor and speed.

## Our Biologic Discovery Solutions

Mosaic delivers integrated discovery programs across antibody engineering, protein science,
cell-based screening, and pharmacology supporting progression from target to candidate.

[Explore All Solutions][24]

### **Antibody Discovery & Optimization**

[View Solution][25]

### **Protein Design & Engineering**

[Scientist using mechanical pipettor to perform protein engineering services.]
[View Solution][26]

### Protein Sciences & Analytics

[View Solution][27]

### Cell-Based Assays

[View Solution][28]

### Pharmacology

[View Solution][29]

## Why Mosaic for Biologic Discovery

Mosaic integrates advanced antibody libraries, protein engineering, function-first screening, and
early developability assessment to accelerate progression from target identification to candidate
selection.

### End-to-end discovery integration

Concept-to-candidate programs run under one team, without fragmenting your workflow across vendors.

### Freedom to operate

Milestone-based, royalty-free access to our proprietary antibody platform, no downstream royalty
stacking on your candidates.

### Function-first screening strategy

Function-first testing and biophysical characterization are embedded at every stage, not bolted on
at the end.

### Complex protein expertise

Deep experience engineering difficult targets, bispecifics, membrane proteins, and other
structurally complex biologics.

### Early developability focus

Developability assessed from day one, catching liabilities before they become late-stage failures.

### FHD technology access

Exclusive access to our Atlas™ FHD platform, fully human antibody repertoires with broad epitope
coverage.

[View Our Approach ][30]

## **Leadership with Proven Biologic Discovery Impact**

Mosaic’s scientific leadership team has built platforms, advanced clinical candidates, and led
discovery programs at leading biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies.

[Meet Our Leadership Team][31]
[CSO, Eric Furfine]

#### Eric Furfine, PhD

**Chief Scientific Officer**

Led IPO-financed Phase 3 programs at Eleven Biotherapeutics. Built the Adnectin platform (acquired
by BMS). Former VP at Regeneron contributing to Eylea development.

#### Alexei Kazantsev, PhD

**Vice President Protein Design and Engineering**

Structural and chemical biology expert. Leads protein engineering and PK optimization at Mosaic.
Prior research in RNA and protein structural biology using X-ray crystallography and SAXS.

[Tracey Mullen, Chief Strategy Officer]

#### Tracey Mullen

**Chief Strategy Officer**

Former SVP Biopharma at Twist Bioscience (post-Abveris acquisition). Former CEO of Abveris. Antibody
discovery leadership experience at Biogen and Adimab platform implementation.

[SVP, Biologics Discovery, Scott Glaser]

#### Scott Glaser PhD

**SVP, Biologics Discovery**

30+ years in biologic drug discovery. Former Director of Antibody Therapeutics at Novartis (GNF) and
senior leadership at Pfizer and Biogen. Contributor to 50+ discovery programs and co-inventor on 23
US patents.

Start a conversation with our scientific team about your discovery program today

## 3D Cell Explorer 96focus

### Nanolive’s automated label-free live cell imaging and analysis solution

Unlock the power of unlimited high content live cell analysis with the [3D Cell Explorer
96focus][57]. Our unique approach enables analysis and re-analysis of label-free image data with our
AI-powered digital assays. As always, the simple, autonomous workflow ensures that your precious
time in the lab is used efficiently, and you can be confident that your samples are in good hands,
whether you are imaging for an hour, or days.

[icon streamlined workflows]

Streamlined, automated work-flows: save time and money

[icon long-term monitoring]

Long-term monitoring of cells label-free

[icon reliable live cell data]

High content, multiplexed, reliable live cell data

[icon digital analytics solutions]

Fully integrated, cutting-edge digital analysis solutions

[Learn more][58]

### Discover Nanolive’s New Label-Free Mitochondrial Analysis

### [Smart Mitochondrial Assay^{LIVE}][59]

Powered by high-resolution label-free imaging and AI-driven analysis, the **Smart Mitochondrial
Assay^{LIVE}** is the world’s first fully automated solution for noninvasive, quantitative
assessment of mitochondrial dynamics. Created to accelerate drug discovery, it provides deeper
insights into mitochondrial responses without any need for dyes or complex sample preparation.

[Learn more >][60]

## Fully integrated cutting-edge digital analytical solutions

Get higher significance earlier and faster with our panel of application specific, push-button
digital assays. Retroactive analysis is also possible at any time.

### [Cytotoxicity ][61]

[*LIVE Cytotoxicity Assay*][62]

Profile cell health and death, and distinguish between living, apoptotic, and necrotic cells
label-free.

[Learn more >][63]

### [Immuno-oncology][64]

[*LIVE T Cell Assay*][65]

Measure and characterize simultaneously how live T cells find, bind, stress, and serial kill their
targets.

[Learn more >][66]

### [Metabolism][67]

 

[*Smart Lipid Droplet Assay*][68]

Measure lipid droplet characteristics at population, cellular, and individual droplet levels.

[Learn more >][69]

Optimization of drug delivery systems can become slow, resource intensive, and reliant on incomplete

phototoxicity from labels and helping teams identify where delivery succeeds or fails.

## 3D Cell Explorer 96focus

### Nanolive’s automated label-free live cell imaging and analysis solution

Unlock the power of unlimited high content live cell analysis with the [3D Cell Explorer
96focus][57]. Our unique approach enables analysis and re-analysis of label-free image data with our
AI-powered digital assays. As always, the simple, autonomous workflow ensures that your precious
time in the lab is used efficiently, and you can be confident that your samples are in good hands,
whether you are imaging for an hour, or days.

[icon streamlined workflows]

Streamlined, automated work-flows: save time and money

[icon long-term monitoring]

Long-term monitoring of cells label-free

[icon reliable live cell data]

High content, multiplexed, reliable live cell data

[icon digital analytics solutions]

Fully integrated, cutting-edge digital analysis solutions

[Learn more][58]

### Discover Nanolive’s New Label-Free Mitochondrial Analysis

### [Smart Mitochondrial Assay^{LIVE}][59]

Powered by high-resolution label-free imaging and AI-driven analysis, the **Smart Mitochondrial
Assay^{LIVE}** is the world’s first fully automated solution for noninvasive, quantitative
assessment of mitochondrial dynamics. Created to accelerate drug discovery, it provides deeper
insights into mitochondrial responses without any need for dyes or complex sample preparation.

[Learn more >][60]

## Fully integrated cutting-edge digital analytical solutions

Get higher significance earlier and faster with our panel of application specific, push-button
digital assays. Retroactive analysis is also possible at any time.

### [Cytotoxicity ][61]

[*LIVE Cytotoxicity Assay*][62]

Profile cell health and death, and distinguish between living, apoptotic, and necrotic cells
label-free.

[Learn more >][63]

### [Immuno-oncology][64]

[*LIVE T Cell Assay*][65]

Measure and characterize simultaneously how live T cells find, bind, stress, and serial kill their
targets.

[Learn more >][66]

### [Metabolism][67]

 

[*Smart Lipid Droplet Assay*][68]

Measure lipid droplet characteristics at population, cellular, and individual droplet levels.

[Learn more >][69]

[ [Amgen Testimonial — Nanolive 3D Microscopy Results] ][70]

## Latest News

## [Simplifying drug delivery assessment: Industry perspectives][71]

Optimization of drug delivery systems can become slow, resource intensive, and reliant on incomplete
information. With one assay, Nanolive monitors the complete dynamics of drug delivery, reducing
phototoxicity from labels and helping teams identify where delivery succeeds or fails.

[Read more][72]

## [Webinar – Investigating nanoparticle delivery with label-free live cell imaging][73]

Watch our latest webinar, where Elizabeth Nelson shares research performed at the MIT Koch Institute
for Integrative Cancer Research, demonstrating a live-cell imaging workflow to quantify the dynamic
uptake of nanoparticles…

[Read more][74]

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological development

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of
scientific excellence, attractive to both industrial and academic scientists in Pharmaceutical &
Novel Drug Delivery systems of Relevant Field.

**Conference Benefits:**

•   Live Sessions
•   Certification of Recognition
•   Meet your Academic idols
•   Hear about latest research
•   Engage in High level debates & Q/A
•   Networking for future collaboration
•   Add Research Value
•   Networking Sessions

**Target Audience**
* Pharma Research Community
* R&D Researchers from Pharma Industries
* Directors of Organizations
* CEO's of Organizations
* Business Development Managers
* Chief Scientific Officers
* Academia
* Drug Delivery Entities
* Medical Groups
* Related Associations
* Biomedical Device Industries
* Medical Device Industries

 

### Sessions and Tracks


**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of
scientific excellence, attractive to both industrial and academic scientists in Pharmaceutical &
Novel Drug Delivery systems of Relevant Field.

**Conference Benefits:**

•   Live Sessions
•   Certification of Recognition
•   Meet your Academic idols
•   Hear about latest research
•   Engage in High level debates & Q/A
•   Networking for future collaboration
•   Add Research Value
•   Networking Sessions

**Target Audience**
* Pharma Research Community
* R&D Researchers from Pharma Industries
* Directors of Organizations
* CEO's of Organizations
* Business Development Managers
* Chief Scientific Officers
* Academia
* Drug Delivery Entities
* Medical Groups
* Related Associations
* Biomedical Device Industries
* Medical Device Industries

 

### Sessions and Tracks


**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

# ILLUMINATE PATHWAYS.

Utilize imaging and machine learning to deliver quantitative cell biology.

PhenoVista is a contract research organization and leading provider of cell-based assays, providing
high-quality data and de-risking R&D decisions for biopharmaceutical clients worldwide.

## The Advantage of High-Content Imaging

With our multiplexed, high content imaging-based phenotypic assays, you get the quantitative data
and biological insights needed to more confidently answer high-stakes questions related to targets
and drug candidates.

[Learn More about Our Expertise][63]

## New Insights for Your Disease Area

[fibroblasts-icon-v4]

**FIBROSIS**

Investigate your drug candidates' effects on fibrotic inhibition and induction.

[**Learn More**][64]

[neuron-icon-v3]

**NEUROBIOLOGY**

Overcome the challenges of CNS-related research and gain insights into your drug candidates.

[**Learn More**][65]

[oncology-icon-v2]

**ONCOLOGY & IMMUNO-ONCOLOGY**

Advance your drug-development campaigns with biologically relevant systems.

[**Learn More**][66]

## WELCOME TO PHENOVISTA

Our mission is simple: Enable life scientists to develop cures within months, not years.

## WHAT SETS US APART

Unmatched Expertise in High-content Imaging & Analysis

We use state-of-the-art imaging instrumentation and advanced, in-house informatics to answer complex
biological questions. With our custom and Ready-2-Go assays, clients get high-quality, quantitative
functional, structural, and mechanistic data for unprecedented insights.

Experience Designing & Performing Difficult Biological Assays

Our team of scientists has diverse expertise ranging from biomedical engineering to neurobiology. We
also have extensive experience working with primary cells, iPSC-derived neurons and glia, and
client-engineered lines in a variety of formats such as 2D, 3D, co-culture, and microfluidic
systems.

A Commitment to Collaboration 

We work with our clients from around the world in a collaborative, adaptable manner to design and
implement physiologically meaningful assays to help answer their unique biological questions.  

## YOUR COLLABORATIVE DISCOVERY PARTNER

Trusted by biotech and pharmaceutical companies around the world.

der Produkt­entwicklung sowie ein umfassendes Service­angebot für alle Ihre Verpackungs­anforderungen.

Technologie

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

# Leading Global Pharmaceutical Company

Salvavidas Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is committed to being the world’s leading manufacturer and
exporter of finished dosage forms (FDFs) and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). Our main goal
is to improve patient outcomes while establishing industry-defining standards. We strive to produce
necessary drugs that are affordable, easily available, and effective.

## We are offering
## best Services & Products

High-quality pharmaceutical, ayurvedic, and antibiotic medications are available from Salvavidas
Pharmaceutical, a well-known pharmaceutical manufacturer and supplier in India. Customers can choose
from a variety of packaging solutions for their items, and flexible payment alternatives. They
guarantee on-time delivery and keep their prices competitive. Salvavidas Pharmaceutical puts the
needs of its patients first by improving safety, efficacy, convenience, and compliance while
offering reasonably priced goods that benefit both patients and society as a whole.

## We Committed for a Better Life

### Salvavidas pharma is a leading pharmaceutical manufacturing and export company in India

We place a high priority on customer happiness, which we accomplish by offering high-quality
medicines on schedule and at fair prices. We promise that every product meets the highest caliber
throughout its development, manufacturing, sale, distribution, etc. We are dedicated to establishing
and preserving solid bonds with our clients worldwide. As a result, we are now recognized as a
reliable exporter offering service globally.

## What we bring to you

Salvavidas Pharma is a well-known Indian pharmaceutical exporter that provides a wide variety of
medications to international markets. The organization, which is based in Surat, Gujarat, is one of
the greatest places to find pharmaceutical items. It provides a wide range of products that are
developed to fulfill the requirements of its customers, such as antimalarials, analgesics, and
antibiotics. Salvavidas Pharma, which has a large worldwide presence, focuses on public health as a
driver for social and economic advancement. It is currently one of the leading pharmaceutical firms
in India.

# Opening new worlds for molecular discovery

Schrödinger’s computational platform, powered by physics, is transforming the way therapeutics and
materials are discovered to make innovations of the future achievable, today.

[Explore Our Platform][153]

## Better therapeutics come from better molecules

Leverage the power of our industry-leading platform to discover and optimize better molecules,
faster.
* [Learn more][154]

[Background][Background]
Materials Science

## Material advances are made on the molecular level

Discover, optimize, and formulate the materials of the future with our predictive computational
platform.
* [Learn more][155]

[Advancing a pipeline of therapeutics built from our platform][Advancing a pipeline of therapeutics
built from our platform]
Pipeline

## Advancing a pipeline of therapeutics built from our platform

Schrödinger’s therapeutics group strives to reduce risk in drug discovery and development by
selecting high-value targets with established human genetics or clinical validation, where we can
solve a design challenge, and where we believe we can deliver value for patients.

#### We deploy our platform to drive a pipeline of collaborative and proprietary drug discovery
#### programs.

[Explore our pipeline][156]

Aqvesme’s FDA Milestone: Expanding Mitapivat’s Reach in Thalassemia Treatment
][9]
22 January 2026
The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

[
The $4B Patent Cliff: Navigating the Generic Surge as Astellas’ Xtandi Nears Expiration
][13]
22 January 2026
Astellas Pharma is facing a defining moment as its blockbuster prostate cancer therapy, Xtandi
(enzalutamide), approaches a massive patent cliff in 2026 and 2027. With billions in annual revenue
at risk, the pharmaceutical giant is pivoting toward aggressive lifecycle management and strategic
BD (Business Development) to offset the impending generic competition. For generic manufacturers and
oncology innovators, this transition creates a high-stakes environment where the ability to rapidly
deconstruct original patent claims and identify "late-stage" IP vulnerabilities is the key to
capturing market share in a post-Xtandi era.

[[2026 BIO International Convention In-Depth Analysis Report]][16]

### [2026 BIO International Convention In-Depth Analysis Report][17]

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,
marked a pivotal moment for the biotechnology industry. With nearly 20,000 attendees from over 76
countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by
record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

[Read →][18]
[[EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][19]

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

Astellas Pharma is facing a defining moment as its blockbuster prostate cancer therapy, Xtandi
(enzalutamide), approaches a massive patent cliff in 2026 and 2027. With billions in annual revenue
at risk, the pharmaceutical giant is pivoting toward aggressive lifecycle management and strategic
BD (Business Development) to offset the impending generic competition. For generic manufacturers and
oncology innovators, this transition creates a high-stakes environment where the ability to rapidly
deconstruct original patent claims and identify "late-stage" IP vulnerabilities is the key to
capturing market share in a post-Xtandi era.

### [2026 BIO International Convention In-Depth Analysis Report][17]

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,
marked a pivotal moment for the biotechnology industry. With nearly 20,000 attendees from over 76
countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by
record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

[[EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][19]

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

Aqvesme’s FDA Milestone: Expanding Mitapivat’s Reach in Thalassemia Treatment
][9]
22 January 2026
The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

## [**Taj Pharmaceuticals**][121], is a [generics pharmaceuticals company][122] with product range
## exceeding 4600 compositions under all therapeutic categories

Taj Pharmaceuticals Limited stands at the forefront of healthcare innovation and compassion. Our
commitment to improving lives is unwavering, as evidenced by our extensive range of pharmaceutical
offerings. We proudly supply prescription solutions, life-saving medications, anti-cancer
treatments, veterinary care products, trusted consumer brands, and cutting-edge CNS drugs.

Our focus extends to a wide spectrum of health concerns, including anemia, anxiety disorders, cancer
and oncology, ear infections, heart failure, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, influenza, non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma,
obesity, osteoporosis, Parkinson’s disease, pneumonia, transplantation, and various common ailments.

With our headquarters nestled in the vibrant city of Mumbai, India, Taj Pharmaceuticals India
Business continues to lead the way in providing healthcare solutions that empower individuals and
communities to thrive. Join us on our journey towards a healthier, brighter future.

Taj Pharmaceuticals stands proudly as a global leader in generics, ranking among the top ten
pharmaceutical companies in India. Our legacy in the field of medicine spans over a century, and our
commitment to innovation and excellence shines through. We have taken the forefront in critical
therapeutic areas such as cancer, virology, and transplantation. What sets us apart is the
harmonious fusion of Taj Pharma’s generic and pharmaceutical divisions, backed by cutting-edge
genetic sciences, allowing us to craft personalized healthcare solutions tailored precisely to
individual patient needs.

At Taj Pharmaceuticals, our mission is clear – to alleviate suffering and elevate the quality of
life for people worldwide. We have tirelessly pursued this noble goal with unwavering patience,
dedication, imagination, and expertise. Our vision revolves around the creation of targeted
medicines and diagnostic tools, uniting to provide patients, physicians, and payers with superior,
safer, and more cost-effective healthcare solutions.

Welcome to Taj Pharmaceuticals, where a profound vision transforms into reality. We are more than
just a company; we are pioneers in Innovating Generics Healthcare.

Taj Pharmaceuticals Limited operates with an unshakable commitment to earn the trust of doctors,
patients, and customers every single day. We understand that trust is a precious currency, and we
invest daily in becoming champions for our stakeholders.

Over the past decade, Taj Pharmaceuticals Group has been diligently shaping a new paradigm in
healthcare. Throughout our organization in India, we nurture enduring relationships founded on
mutual confidence. This commitment is evident in our actions – our scientists earn trust through
groundbreaking discoveries, our sales and marketing teams work tirelessly to improve global health,
and our colleagues at every level strive to be trustworthy.

This journey demands relentless effort, impeccable execution, unwavering integrity, and transparency
from all Taj Pharmaceuticals Group members. Our global team remains resolute in expanding innovative
treatments and increasing access to quality healthcare worldwide. We aspire to excellence in three
core areas: our people, our products, and our processes.

The fruits of our labor are beginning to emerge, but we believe the best is yet to come. True
champions never relent; they tirelessly pursue better outcomes. As a healthcare company, our purpose
is to help people worldwide live better and longer lives.

Our product range encompasses a wide array of major generic drugs, spanning therapeutic categories
such as anti-cancer drugs, CNS medications, and key medicines for conditions like anemia, anxiety
disorders, heart failure, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, and more. Taj Pharmaceuticals is dedicated to
improving the human condition by providing effective solutions for common diseases and complex
medical challenges.

###  TAJ PHARMA MANUFACTURING

Our world class finished dosage manufacturing facility is located at At Village – Kalgam,Coastal
Highway Road,Dist. – Valsad, Gujrat – 396142.India in the middle of the some of the major generic
players of the world. The facility has dedicated manufacturing modules for oral solid dosages
Tablet, Capsule, Small Volume Parenterals, Injection, Dry Injection, Syrups & Suspensions ,
Ointments , Dry Syrups and caters to export and domestic markets.
* A Scale up and a Commercial module for Solid dosages
* Two Modules for Sterile manufacturing
* Class 10,000 and Class 1000 controlled conditions. 17 dedicated AHUs to control individual areas.
  Terminal Hepa filters in core processing area

Some of salient features of our facilities are
• Class 10,000 and Class 1000 controlled conditions. 17 dedicated AHUs to control individual areas.
Terminal Hepa filters in core processing area
• Capable of wet/dry granulation, direct compression, film coating and blister/strip/alu-alu packing
• The Purified Water Distribution loop confirming to USP only
• Comprehensive utilities (Boilers, Chilled & Hot water, Air compressors, H.T Electricity incl. DG
and UPS)
• GCs, HPLCs with PDA, UV Spectrophotometers, IR, PSD, DSC
• Absolute focus on Safety, Health & Environment
• Gearing up for ISO 9001 and 14001 (EMS) certifications
• Factory cGMP, WHO, UKMHRA Approved

### Taj Pharmaceuticals Ltd has it's manufacturing facility for the below mention categories of
### pharmaceutical products.

Tablet 22 lac per shift Capsule 22 lac per shift Injection 2.5 lac per shift Dry Injection 3.5 lac
per shift Small Volume Parenterals 4.5 lac per shift Syrups & Suspensions 1.5 lac per shift
Ointments 2.5 lac per shift Dry Syrups 1.5 lac per shift
Manufacturing (Capacity)

[[flask][flask]][123]State-of-the art Liquid Injections (SVP Line) and General Dry Powder
facilities, which adhere to stringent specifications of GMP and WHO-GMP; We are International
standard contract manufacturing Organization.

[[spinner][spinner]][124]Taj Pharma leverages its India units as cost effective manufacturing
together with its extensive expertise and technology platforms to offer competitive, high quality,
custom manufacturing services to a global clientele. Our facility has been inspected by various
international regulators including the USFDA, GMP, WHO & ISO Certified.

[[clock][clock]][125]Taj Pharma’s manufacturing facilities operate to the highest standards of
quality control. Tests produced at all four of our sites are manufactured to stringent levels of
reliability, reproducibility and stability.

> Once again, welcome to [Taj Pharmaceuticals][126], a great company that is translating a great
> vision of generics into reality – We Innovate Generics Healthcare.
